action.layout_note: 14 controls: right arm 6, left arm 6, right gripper 1, left gripper 1. OSC frame moves with vehicle.

reset.variation: Explicit Episode variation applied before compilation; reset repeats that Episode exactly.

spec: 18 m road, start XY=(0,1.5), yaw=pi/2; obstacle Y=[4.5,10,15], sides=[-1,+1,-1]
20 Hz / 180 s; joystick range +/-0.18, deadzone 0.10, stiffness3; fixed ALOHA mounting and initialization
kinematic vehicle update and 0.95 m collision envelope, binary arrival scoring, parameter domains
task_instance: road.half_width_m (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
obstacle.extension_m (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
obstacle.half_width_m (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
vehicle.nominal_speed_m_s (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
vehicle.steering_gain (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
joystick.damping (baseline; Episode may override fields listed in episode_randomization)
derived: obstacle xo=side*(H+.05-e)/2; sx=(H+.05+e)/2; all obstacles share e and sy

rules.drive: u=clip(q/.18,-1,1); drive=sign(u)*max(0,abs(u)-.10)/.90; speed=V*(L+R)/2; yaw_rate=G*(R-L); update yaw then XY every .05 s
rules.blocked: reject candidate XY/yaw if abs(x)>H-.95 or y outside [.95,17.05] or any abs(x-xo)<sx+.95 AND abs(y-yo)<sy+.95; report zero speed; recoverable, no penalty
rules.success: accepted vehicle center y>=16.8; score100 and drive_finished then terminate, regardless of prior blocks
rules.timeout: 3600 steps/180 s; last-step success takes precedence; otherwise truncate with score0
rules.score: 100 on success, otherwise0; no partial points; score_key total_score
rules.reset: Reset restores car XY/yaw, drives, steps, blocked state, mocap and moving OSC origin with the explicit Episode speed gain.
rules.feasibility: no ALOHA grasp or driving demonstration recertification

episode_randomization.storage: Episode variation + runtime + initial_state; Task scenario is the baseline
episode_randomization.schedule: independently shuffled five-stratum batches; two practice batches and one exam batch use the same domain; phone small count alternates 2/3
episode_randomization.replay: rebuild resolved Episode model; verify full runtime identity; restore exact initial state; no resampling during reset/step
episode_randomization.policy_visibility: qualitative runtime English instructions only; sampled values, solution axes, small-support names and files remain private
